en.title: Chapter Outline Preserving Original Titles
en.description:
A line that starts exactly with "# " is a chapter title, a line that starts with "## " is a section title, and all other lines are ignored. Chapters are numbered from 1, and section numbers restart from 1 in each new chapter; output "<chapter>. <title>" or "<chapter>.<section>. <title>". Only the fixed prefix is removed; all whitespace and Unicode characters within the title are kept as is, and empty titles are allowed.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric constraints are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The input is a JSON array of strings text. Full original bounds: 1≤number of lines≤1000, and each string has length 1..100 in Unicode code points; the first line is guaranteed to start with "# ". A leading # marker is only # or ## and is followed by a space. The original text does not restrict the character set, so it is not narrowed to ASCII; JSON escapes may represent control characters such as tabs, and title content is not trimmed.
en.output: Output a single-line canonical JSON array of strings, followed by a newline: one space after each comma in the array; non-ASCII characters are output directly; double quotes, backslashes and control characters are escaped per JSON (backspace/tab/newline/form feed/carriage return use \b/\t/\n/\f/\r, and the remaining U+0000..U+001F use lowercase four-digit \u00xx); slashes are not escaped. This matches Python json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False). This encoding preserves every title character and avoids NUL in the output; an exact check is used.
en.explanation: The first example outputs ["1. Cars", "1.1. Sedan", "1.2. Coupe", "1.3. SUV"]. In the second example, section numbers reset after a new chapter. In the third example, the titles contain spaces, tabs and an empty title; after JSON decoding, the titles must be preserved character by character.
hints: Scan in order, maintaining the chapter number and the current section number. On a chapter, increment the chapter number and reset the section number; on a section, increment the section number; then join the number, one separating space and the original title with its marker removed.
